description: This Java source file defines the UserDictionaryEditorFragment class, which is part of an Android application for editing user dictionaries within the AnySoftKeyboard project. It manages UI components such as spinners and recycler views to display and modify user-defined words, handles asynchronous loading of dictionary data, and provides methods for adding, updating, and deleting words in the dictionary.

classes.name: UserDictionaryEditorFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class for editing user dictionary words, providing UI for listing, adding, updating, and deleting words, with asynchronous data loading and interaction handling.

classes.name: LoadedWord
classes.description: A simple data class representing a word and its frequency in the user dictionary.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's view, sets up the custom action bar with a spinner for language selection.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components such as the spinner and recycler view, sets layout managers based on resource configuration.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for adding new words.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically adding a new empty word entry.

methods.name: fillLanguagesSpinner
methods.description: Populates the language selection spinner with enabled keyboard locales.

methods.name: fillWordsList
methods.description: Loads the words from the selected dictionary asynchronously, sorts them, and updates the recycler view.

methods.name: createAdapterForWords
methods.description: Creates an adapter for displaying the list of loaded words.

methods.name: onWordDeleted
methods.description: Handles deletion of a word asynchronously.

methods.name: onWordUpdated
methods.description: Handles updating or adding a word asynchronously.

methods.name: deleteWord
methods.description: Deletes a word from the current dictionary.

methods.name: createEditableDictionary
methods.description: Creates an instance of the editable dictionary for a given locale.
